name: Sigma join by sorting
plain: Puts two schedules together by dropping the first value of the second one, concatenating, and sorting everything high to low. When the two ranges overlap, the values interleave instead of the second schedule following the first. If the first schedule already ends in 0 (a normal full schedule), that 0 is kept, so the result ends with two zeros: a zero-length final step. Duplicate values are never removed.
math:
Symbols: σ¹, σ² input schedules.
σ = sort_desc(σ¹ ++ σ²[1:]).
